summary: Comprehensive testing of SkyTech Uzbek e-commerce. Backend pytest: 31/32 passed (only 1 race-condition test failure due to parallel session sharing same user cart - not a backend bug). All API endpoints (auth, products, cart, wishlist, orders, coupons, chat, reviews, admin) work correctly. Frontend: home, auth, products, product detail, cart, wishlist, user dashboard, admin dashboard (all 4 tabs render with stats: revenue 5,400,000 so'm, 4 orders, 9 products, 4 customers), chat widget, and footer (phone +998 94 884 64 46, telegram skytech_shop, instagram skytech_uz) all work. UI is fully in Uzbek. One critical frontend bug found in Checkout page.

minor.issue: When same user token is used concurrently for cart ops in parallel test workers, last-write-wins causes test race (not a production bug, but isolation concern in load scenarios)

ui_bugs.issue: navigate('/cart') is called inside the render body when cart.items is empty/loading. This triggers React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Checkout)' and causes /checkout to always bounce to /cart on direct visit because CartContext hasn't populated cart.items on first render. Fix: move the navigate call into a useEffect that watches cart.items.

action_items: Fix Checkout.js (lines 150-153): replace the inline `if (!cart.items || cart.items.length === 0) { navigate('/cart'); return null; }` with a useEffect-based redirect, e.g. `useEffect(() => { if (cartLoaded && (!cart.items || cart.items.length === 0)) navigate('/cart'); }, [cart.items])`. Also handle cart loading state to avoid premature redirect.
Optional: also ensure CartContext exposes a `loading` flag so Checkout can render a spinner while cart fetches.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is a single 800-line file; consider splitting into modules (auth, products, cart, orders, admin) for maintainability (>700 lines guideline).
JWT_SECRET defaults to a literal string if env is missing - acceptable but warning-worthy.
/api/coupons/validate uses query params (per spec) but a POST with body would be more idiomatic; current implementation works.
Checkout.js setState/navigate during render is a React anti-pattern (only critical functional issue found).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data needed; existing seed contains 9 products, 6 categories, 2 users, 2 coupons.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid - run /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py for regression. Skip parallel xdist (use -p no:xdist) to avoid TestCart vs TestAdmin race on shared user cart. Frontend: after Checkout.js fix, re-test full purchase flow: login user@test.uz -> /products -> add to cart -> /checkout -> fill shipping (full_name, phone, address, city, region, postal_code) -> step-shipping-next -> select payment -> step-payment-next -> place-order-btn -> verify order in /dashboard.
rca_of_the_issue: Checkout.js renders for the first time before CartContext finishes loading the cart from the API. At that moment cart.items is either undefined or [], so the guard at lines 150-153 fires navigate('/cart') synchronously inside the render function. React then warns about setting state on another component (Router) during render, and the user is redirected away from /checkout even when they have items in their cart. Reproduction: 1) login as user@test.uz, 2) add a product to cart from /products, 3) directly navigate to /checkout (e.g. clicking the cart's Rasmiylashtirish button or pasting URL) - page bounces to /cart instead of showing checkout steps. Mitigation: wrap the redirect in useEffect with cart.items dependency, and gate it on a 'cartLoaded' flag from CartContext.
